links.outcome: Agreement of AI growth score with blinded technologist reads on local urine cultures
links.effect: Exact agreement across four growth categories 86.2%; at <10^6 CFU/L threshold overall agreement 95.9%, PPA 89.9%, NPA 98.9%; 30.5% of cultures met auto-release or batch-review threshold.
links.quote: Using a <10<sup>6</sup> CFU/L triage threshold, the overall agreement was 95.9%, with positive and negative percent agreement of 89.9% and 98.9%, respectively.

screen.reason: The study evaluates a commercial AI application (BD Kiestra UCA) for automated urine culture triage and presumptive identification, specifically testing different triage reporting thresholds (<10^6 CFU/L) for safe auto-release or batch-review.
